fluff.overview: Conventional infantry within the FWLM serve as the backbone of provincial defense across a patchwork of semi-autonomous states, each maintaining its own military traditions and equipment preferences. Foot infantry platoons form the garrison backbone of the League's provincial militaries, assigned to hold ground on worlds that BattleMech forces cannot permanently occupy. Quality varies with provincial investment, but even modest foot platoons benefit from the FWLM's tradition of equipping infantry with reliable, standardized kit. Carrying infantry-portable long-range missile systems, these platoons provide indirect fire capability that extends their engagement envelope well beyond personal weapons range, though the weight and bulk of the launchers reduce the platoon's mobility.
